title: Implement IFX C1 source import, declaration, forbidden-symbol and payload candidate
goal: Reproduce bounded V3 source-policy predicates through a read-only V4 public extension without claiming compiled or production parity.
acceptanceCriteria: Frozen V3 IFX policy, G03 and semantic source projections and hashes are asserted, with nonvacuous per-rule coverage.
Fixtures verify active/inactive import, declaration/index, symbol, payload, exceptions, missing, zero, unsafe and deterministic evidence while preserving TargetRoot bytes.
Real IFX scan, published-base synthetic Host Pre, isolated IFX package regression and unchanged Package hash are recorded.
Formal Pre precedes candidate edits and exact Formal Diff passes; no production Profile or full C1 claim is made.
